A tenacious '''bounty hunter''' once sought a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on a [[Unidentified Corellian smuggler (Credit Case Surprise)|famous Corellian smuggler]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] managed to escape the bounty hunter by rigging a [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] case with a powerful [[Spotlight/Legends|spotlight]] that emitted a blinding light when opened. The idea led to an entrepreneur creating the "[[Credit Case Surprise]]."<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
